primary_reference_geometry: R_core^0 = the independently validated neutral n0 PAl12 minimum, mapped atoms 1–13. Use its single aligned Cartesian core for every fixed-core state and n.
free: Independently optimize both charge states and compare plausible spin/binding-site candidates. No core restraints on an endpoint asserted to be a free minimum.
fixed_core: Freeze mapped atoms 1–13 at R_core^0 and relax ligand atoms separately for each charge state; n0 fixed-core is two electronic single points at the common core. Do not label these constrained states as free minima or transfer free frequencies to them.
vertical: At each retained neutral free geometry compute anion energy/density without moving nuclei, on a justified anion state. Evaluate neutral and anion density on the same grid.

definitions.fixed_core_attachment: E_neutral(R_core0,R_ligN)-E_anion(R_core0,R_ligA); constrained-core attachment quantity, not a free AEA
definitions.relaxation_contribution: AEA_electronic-VEA_electronic = E_anion(R_neutral)-E_anion(R_anion), provided energy/state references are explicitly matched
definitions.attachment_density: rho_anion(R_neutral)-rho_neutral(R_neutral), electron-number density integrates to +1 electron; charge density would have the opposite sign.

population: Use the same core atoms 1–13 and ligand A/B partitions with one defined population scheme for both states. Report both charge differences and integrated attachment density; one population charge alone cannot separate polarization from electron localization.
mechanistic_boundary: Frozen-core controls diagnose structural relaxation; attachment-density localization plus charge partition can support or challenge ligand acceptance. They do not uniquely isolate an electrostatic Hamiltonian term. Do not claim exclusive polarization from correlations; electrostatic embedding/CDA extensions are optional.
candidates: n0: spin and core distortion starts. n1: symmetry-distinct Al approach and ligand torsions. n2: adjacent versus separated shell attachment sites and ligand orientations, deduplicated after relaxation. Include actual collapse/reconstruction logs and distinguish failure from evidence-supported exclusion.
gate: Validate the original complete n2=PAl12[B(C6F5)3]2 neutral/anion DFT minimum pair before the full expansion. Bare n0 and n1 may be lower-cost preparatory diagnostics but do not close this original-object gate.
historical_developer_gate: Historical n2 local-minimum evidence permits targeted missing-control validation. The original-object and density gates still require actual submitted evidence; a developer readiness statement is not an agent result.
